findings.claim: Docs link to github.com/sgl-project/rbg-planner (404) and install from oci://ghcr.io/sgl-project/charts/rbg-planner / ghcr.io/sgl-project/rbg-profiler; the project lives at github.com/rolebasedgroup/rbg-planner and publishes no OCI chart (README: local chart path; image CI pushes to Docker Hub).
Docs say metricSource is 'sglang | vllm | dynamo'; shipped CRD enum is sglang|vllm|patio - 'dynamo' is rejected by API validation, 'patio' undocumented.
Docs describe metricsEndpoint.port: 8000 as the inference engine metrics port; upstream wires it to PLANNER_PROMETHEUS_PORT (the planner's own metrics exposition port, default 9091).
'kubectl get/logs -l app=rbg-planner' selects zero pods; planner engine pods are labeled app.kubernetes.io/name=rbg-planner (+instance).
Related Documents sections carry a stale 'documents have not been created yet' TODO and plain-text bullets, but docs 01-04 exist on main and sibling docs (05,07) link them.
zh concept doc has 3 AutoCorrect lint errors (halfwidth comma after CJK; missing spaces around hyphens); rest of doc tree is clean. CI runs autocorrect in fix mode so it stays green.

liveNote: Docs-only PR: no live layer. The guide's kubectl workflows were verified by code inspection (RBGSA CRD scale subresource, controller sync, planner deployment labels) rather than a cluster.
